mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT PO.POLICY_ID AS policyId, PO.POLICY_CODE AS policyCode, PO.EFFECT AS effect, PR.RULE_ID AS ruleId, PR.SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE AS subjectAttribute, PR.OPERATOR AS operator, PR.RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTE AS resourceAttribute, PR.EXPECTED_VALUE AS expectedValue, PR.DESCRIPTION AS description FROM PERMISSIONS P INNER JOIN PERMISSION_POLICIES PP ON P.PER_ID = PP.PER_ID INNER JOIN POLICIES PO ON PP.POLICY_ID = PO.POLICY_ID INNER JOIN POLICY_RULES PR ON PO.POLICY_ID = PR.POLICY_ID WHERE P.PER_CODE = #{permissionCode} AND P.ENABLED = TRUE AND PP.ENABLED = TRUE AND PO.ENABLED = TRUE AND PR.ENABLED = TRUE
